notes: Random record words/dwords (often 0, negative or 1) and default table reached through a random real-mode seg:off and segment base; descriptor default count 0 or not; random 0x4dd7f0 flag. cdecl stack arguments. 0x101f88 logs its handle, message and fourth argument, copies the mode word at +6 of the block its third argument points to (the rest of that block is uninitialised stack in the original), returns random values and clobbers EBX/ECX/EDX.
